analyst.summary: Thyrocare's testing volumes and franchise network are growing at a healthy double-digit pace with a clean, low-debt balance sheet. However, profit growth this year has run well ahead of revenue and operating profit growth, which suggests part of the reported profit jump is a one-time or below-the-core-business item rather than pure operating improvement. Combined with a rich valuation (~51x earnings), we rate this a Hold: a solid business, but not one offering a margin of safety at current prices.
